## First launch on macOS

Toolbox for macOS is not notarized by Apple yet, so the first launch shows a
warning that Toolbox can't be opened or that Apple could not verify it.

1. Open the DMG and drag **Toolbox** to **Applications**.
2. Open Toolbox once, then close the warning.
3. Open **System Settings > Privacy & Security**, scroll to **Security**, and
   click **Open Anyway** next to the Toolbox message. Confirm with your password
   or Touch ID.

On macOS 14 or earlier, you can instead Control-click Toolbox in Applications
and choose **Open**. You only need to do this once.

On Windows, install Toolbox from the
[Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9N5R8W4GJVH4).
